main.description: A patron's posted quest: the work, the reward, and the canonical skills it needs. An anchor that settlements and ratings point at. Written to the patron's repo. Monetary amounts settle OFF-protocol (Stripe); see org.buildguild.settlement.

reward.description: Human-readable reward (e.g. 'revenue share', '$500', 'kudos'). Monetary value is escrowed off-protocol.
